item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 27/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over the coast of southern China over the weekend. It will be rather cool in the morning and cold over inland areas, where the temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. With the monsoon moderating early next week, daytime temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. It will be mild with sunny periods during the day over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week.
